shots.name: 01-introduction
shots.caption: GridGuide 1.1.0 release candidate. Independently authored fictional examples, not live utility observations. No deployment or safety certification.

shots.name: 02-path
shots.caption: Declared power paths distinguish repair prerequisites from customer dependencies. Python prepared these milestone results.

shots.name: 03-completed
shots.caption: Completed means the fictional dependency repairs are complete at this modeled milestone. It does not mean utility-confirmed restoration.

shots.name: 04-blocked
shots.caption: Blocked access has unknown clearance. Full modeled completion stays unavailable; it is never converted to a finite ETR.

shots.name: 05-unresolved
shots.caption: Unresolved evidence stays visible. No validated outage probability or empirically calibrated restoration confidence is available.

shots.name: 06-tradeoff
shots.caption: Four policies use identical assumptions. Critical-first improves one critical latency but worsens total customer-hours. Release/person-hour remains the default; optional CP-SAT is frozen and experimental.

shots.name: 07-override
shots.caption: This supported precedence override is recomputed by Python and independently validated. Changing the scenario or review invalidates earlier acknowledgement.

shots.name: 08-review
shots.caption: Explicit acknowledgements produce a reproducible fictional review record. Checksums establish consistency, not authenticated reviewer identity or tamper-proof history.

shots.name: 09-replay
shots.caption: Actual CLI output from the downloaded JSON. Replay recomputes baselines and validates metrics; it does not rerun CP-SAT.

shots.name: 10-offline
shots.caption: Actual server shutdown and browser networking disabled. Only the reviewed kit and explicitly saved historical fiction remain. No browser numerical engine or live outage awareness.
